family: Precast pretensioned PC I-girder designed for Cambodian short-span bridge rehabilitation (self-compacting concrete)

source.title: VONG Seng, Design of Prestressed Concrete Bridge Girder Using Self-Compacting Concrete for Cambodian Rehabilitation, doctoral dissertation (博士論文), Kochi University of Technology, August 2006
source.locator: PDF page 30 = printed page 28, section 3.3, Fig.3.3.2 'Selected girders'
source.source_status: doctoral-thesis study design (2006); real-scale girder produced and tested under Cambodian climate; not an MPWT standard

TB_12_f60.notes: Chain 200 + 450 + 200 = 850; top flange 160 at the edge with a 40 mm haunch to the web over the 200 zone; bottom flange 120 at the edge with an 80 mm splay. Sharp corners as drawn. The eccentricity 402.2 mm is a tendon value, not a section property.
